notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood after 2-week hosted API trial. Primary goal: ship conversational support + document search with predictable costs. Team initially tried hosted API; now sizing Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation.

Trial highlights (hosted API): ran with sandbox traffic that mirrored 10% of prod for two weeks. Observed: avg 12 QPS, median concurrency 8, peak 34 QPS during weekly digest runs. Avg chat tokens per request ~220 (prompt+response). Embeddings jobs ran asynchronously (batch) — ~20k embeddings/day, avg tokens 40. Reranking pipeline executed at request-time for search heavy queries (approx 8% of total requests).

Business requirements: 99.9% availability SLAs for customer-facing chat, <250ms median generation latency for short help queries, cost target ~$0.01–0.03 per active session (long-tail allowed on heavy queries), data cannot be stored in shared tenancy for >30 days, must support SSO for internal tools.

Technical ask from POC: Redwood to provide recommended Dedicated capacity for steady-state and peak, cost estimates (monthly committed + per-token fallback), routing policy to fall back to hosted-tier during spikes, and guidance on batching/caching to meet cost targets. They want a deterministic sizing exercise: QPS→concurrency→token mix → GPU footprint.

Redwood engagement history: AE Nina intro 2024-10-01. Demo w/ SE Connor 2024-10-10 (hosted demo + streaming). Hosted trial provisioned 2024-10-15 (credit applied). Deep dive on performance/metrics 2024-11-06 with infra/ops. Security questionnaire submitted 2024-11-08.

POC ask quoted on call 2024-11-06: "We need a predictable bill and an answer for peak days — e.g., product launch spikes — without paying cloud overages." Product director emphasized: "If we can get a clear ratio of expected QPS per GPU and a safety multiplier, procurement signs faster."

POC/Traffic specifics provided by customer (sample):
- Observed hosted trial average QPS: 12 (2 weeks)
- Observed hosted trial peak QPS: 34
- Expected production steady QPS: 50–75 (Q1 ramp)
- Expected production peak QPS (launch days): 180–220 for 2–6 hour windows
- Target concurrency during peak: 30–45 active streams
- Request mix estimate: 70% short-chat (avg tokens ~200), 20% embeddings/batch (avg tokens ~40), 10% reranking/longer responses (avg tokens ~900)
